### CRUINNIÚ Abhainn studio Enniscrone 05.08.23@4pm

![Abhainn](images/abhainn.jpg)

As promised, THENCF is going on tour.  We are spinning up the road to visit our sandy, salty, arty, Sligo neighbours this coming August Bank holiday weekend.

We are kindly being hosted by Easkey native Noel Feeney, who recently (lucky for us) decided to leave [hen's teeth in Dublin](https://www.hensteethstore.com/) to set up his own amazing new studio [Abhainn in Enniscrone](https://www.instagram.com/abhainn_studio/).

As if they didn't have enough to be doing, Noel and his crew recently [opened up the old church in Enniscrone as a cultural space](https://www.instagram.com/enniscroneindoormarket/) - check it out if you get a chance.

The plan for this meetup is pretty simple - there will be BBQ, drinks, Art (Abhainn is also exhibiting a number of local artists at the moment) and DJs.  Don't forget to BYOB (if you forget, there's a shop around the corner). Beidh Gaeilig le cluins ag an gcruinniú chomh maith.

If you don't have a car or want to drink, [there's regular buses from Ballina to Enniscrone](https://buseireann.ie/inner.php?id=406&form-view-timetables-from=Enniscrone+%28Main+Street+Hardware%29&form-view-timetables-to=Ballina+%28Bus+Station%29&form-view-timetables-route=&form-view-timetables-submit=1) (2.70 one way with leap card) with the last one going back at 22:40, loads of time to have a good time.
